Rainy Sky SA v Kookmin Bank [2011] 1 WLR 2900 — business-common-sense reading where rival meanings are tenable
Ladd v Marshall [1954] 1 WLR 1489 (CA) — three-prong conjunctive test for admissibility of new evidence at trial
Assignment Agreement (17 February 2023) — clauses 2(b), 7, 10 (substantive); clause 12 (governing law: English)
rule_source.applicable_law_note: Substantive law of contract: English (Assignment Agreement clause 12). Procedural/evidential law: ADGM (lex fori).

events.note: HealthX Pakistan loses access at 03:27 due to non-renewal of user certificate; Pulsar declined nominal USD 100 fee
Xetech tendered Supplementary Trial Bundle de bene esse

human_findings_required: Clause 2(b): the second instalment is payable on 'completion of Phase 2', not on transfer of source code
Clause 7: source code is transferred AFTER receipt of Purchase Price by Xetech
Clause 10: transfer of liabilities (and IP) is subject to payment of GBP 500,000
All three clauses point the same way — payment precedes transfer (judgment para 59-60)
Burden on Xetech (claimant) to prove 'completion' on the balance of probabilities (para 63)
Source code reached state of 'completion' at the time payment was demanded (para 92)
Pulsar's Supplementary Trial Bundle was not 'fresh' — could have been obtained with reasonable diligence (para 48, prong (a) of Ladd v Marshall)
Probative value of the new evidence did not reach the standard for late admission (para 48, prong (b))

human_ruling.interpretation_holding: Xetech entitled to be paid before transfer of source code

human_ruling.post_judgment_interest_basis: 0.75% per month from dates of default until full payment, per clause 2 of the Assignment Agreement (para 99(a)(ii)); quantum left with liberty to apply (para 99(b))
human_ruling.constructive_finding: The case is methodologically distinct from Traces #1-#4: the rule is *Boolean*, not arithmetic. The court's reasoning is the conjunction of three named conjunctive predicates — clause-alignment (clauses 2(b), 7, 10), evidentiary preponderance (named witnesses for/against), and Ladd v Marshall (three prongs, monotonic and short-circuiting). The protocol does not replace any of the substantive findings — clause meaning, witness credibility, document availability are kept human. What it makes auditable is the *logical structure*: that the court's holding follows from the conjunction of named, individually-recorded findings. This is the boundary the original Maxim brief contemplated for 'ad-hoc arbitration' cases.
human_ruling.comparator_to_prior_traces: #1 (formula): pure arithmetic. #2 (deferred conditional): temporal predicate. #3 (bounded discretion): residue is the answer. #4 (composition over findings): arithmetic composition of substantive determinations. #5 (conjunctive logical composition): Boolean composition over named clause/witness/prong findings. Together the five traces span the methodological space the protocol claims — formula, conditional, bounded discretion, arithmetic composition, logical composition.
human_ruling.diversifies_corpus: First substantive contract-interpretation trace from ADGM (trace #4 was also ADGM but turned on UAE Civil Code Art. 390 + ADGM CPR; this one turns on English contractual interpretation principles, demonstrating the cross-jurisdictional reach of the protocol within a single tribunal).
